name: Infantry_Desktop
author: Infantry AI
description: A desktop layout: a plain wallpaper with an icon for the orchestrator and one for Apps. The orchestrator opens full screen in exactly its usual layout; its header's minimize, maximize and close drive the real window like any Windows app. A taskbar along the bottom shows each open app, with a Start menu at its left end that opens the apps and minimizes or exits the whole window; the orchestrator's entry carries how many agents work and how many need you. The start layout of a device that has not chosen one. Replaceable: any layout plugin can take its place.
